name: Shared PR owners receive a coherent paginated observation and durable maintainer signals; acknowledgement is exact
Transient parallel HTTP 500 reads retry once and recover silently
Concurrent persistent failures stay stage-sorted, private, episode-deduplicated, and preserve pending/verdict evidence
Oversized, invalid, and truncated HTTP diagnostics cannot fabricate a status or disclose private text
Head drift rejects mixed evidence and a deadline-killed core read preserves exact record bytes
Malformed second URL does not inherit the first URL HTTP failure
Owned issue still observes comments and ready-for-pr timeline events
